jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**We’re Watts. Together, we’re reimagining the future of water.**


We feel proud every day about what we do. We're all part of the same crucial mission, no matter what function we support \- it's to provide safe, clean water for the world, and to protect our planet's most valuable resource.

**What we do:**


For 150 years, Watts has built best\-in\-class products that are trusted by customers in residential and commercial settings across the world. We are at the forefront of innovation, working with cutting\-edge technology to provide smart and connected, sustainable water solutions for the future. Watts is a leading brand with a quality reputation — and we have a dynamic future ahead.


**Scope of Position**


This highly organized and detail\-oriented individual, as part of the Taft Engineering team, supports the successful execution of project and sales activities by coordinating across internal teams, customers, vendors, and contractors. The role ensures timely, accurate deliverables and a high level of customer satisfaction through responsive communication and seamless project support in a fast\-paced environment.

  

This position reports to the District Sales Manager. This role is onsite and is based in Colorado.

 **Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provide sales support for Taft Engineering team.
* Generate Purchase Orders for Engineering projects.
* Communicate and coordinate with external vendors for necessary project forms including vendors set up, w9 form, COI, etc.
* Communicate and coordinate with end users for necessary project forms including customer setup forms, w9 forms, certificate of insurance forms, etc.
* Enter required information in Taft software for customers, vendors, contractors, etc.
* Provide administrative support to make sure appropriate forms and documents are correctly filled out and completed for each project.
* Coordinate with the accounting department and provide necessary documents/information for projects.
* Create and maintain shared electronic file system to store all project documents.
* Assist engineering project managers with administrative support.
* Receive, generate, and record project invoices and forward to accounting.
* Create and maintain CRM records for projects.
* Assist project managers with proposal development for Taft Engineering projects.
* Coordinate submittals with customers and contractors. Track and file approvals in appropriate job folders.
* Work closely with the internal team members and external sales and support teams to ensure high customer satisfaction
* Travel in support of sales for training, meetings, and customer site visits.
* Cover voicemail and email for sales staff while members are on vacation or unable to access their mailbox.
* Monitor phone system and answer customer calls.

 **Required Qualifications**

* 1\+ years of project coordinator experience.
* Understanding of and adherence to applicable laws, codes, policies, regulations, and safety practices and procedures, as applicable.
* Must successfully establish employment eligibility and satisfactorily complete background checks and required pre\-employment testing as a condition of employment.
* Experience and knowledge of Microsoft office programs.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* College degree preferred but not required.

 **General Applicable Company Competencies**

* Commitment to Watts’ values of integrity, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation, and transparency.
* Punctuality and dependability.
* Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing work priorities and stressful conditions.
* Adherence to all personnel policies, procedures, and standards of process as implemented by Watts.
* Maintain productive and collaborative relationships with other Watts employees.
* Adherence to Watts’ seven cultural beliefs: Growth Mindset, Customer\-Focused Innovation, Constant Communication, Clear Goals, Collaborate Globally, Be Inclusive, and Take Action.

 **Working Conditions**


While performing the job duties, you will be working onsite at a sales office/warehouse facility and will perform the majority of your duties in an office environment. You may, at times, be required to wear the appropriate personal protective equipment. You will be required to work in the office at the Taft Engineering location (Monday – Friday). Your scheduled work hours will be communicated to you by your manager.

 **Physical Requirements**

*Specific physical abilities required for this position include, but are not limited to:*

* Ability to perform repetitive tasks such as typing on a keyboard or using a mouse for extended periods.
* Ability to move about the office to organize, transport, or retrieve files, packages, or other office\-related materials.
* Ability to read documents, use a computer, and perform data entry.
* Ability to communicate clearly with management and coworkers, including during meetings and phone calls.
* Ability to operate standard office equipment, including computers, printers, phones, and copiers.

 **Pay Range**

  

The expected salary range for this position is $26\.15 \- $28\.40 hourly. Actual compensation will be dependent upon individual skills, experience, qualifications, and applicable law.

  

Nothing in this job description restricts Watts’ right to assign or reassign duties, responsibilities, and working hours/conditions to this position at any time. This position is “at will,” which means that either the employee or Watts may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without notice, and for any lawful reason.

 **\#LIOnsite**

 **Watts in it for you**:

***Please note that the following******benefits apply only to permanent roles and do not apply to internship roles.***

* Competitive compensation based on your skills, qualifications and experience
* Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits
* Family building benefits, including paid maternity/paternity leave
* 10 paid holi

jobs.title: Data Analyst - REMOTE
jobs.description:
Overview:
**Data Analyst – REMOTE**
Auto Insurance Specialists **Amazing Opportunity****Excellent corporate career opportunity**! We are currently recruiting a dedicated, service\-oriented professional who is interested in an analyst career. This position will be working remotely from home. ***An in\-person interview may be required during the hiring process***  

State specific pay scales for this role are as follows:  

$98,568 to $120,473 (CA, NJ, NY, WA, HI, AK, MD, CT, RI, MA)
$88,712 to $108,425 (NV, OR, AZ, CO, WY, TX, ND, MN, MO, IL, WI, FL, GA, MI, OH, VA, PA, DE, VT, NH, ME)
$78,855 to $96,378 (UT, ID, MT, NM, SD, NE, KS, OK, IA, AR, LA, MS, AL, TN, KY, IN, SC, NC, WV) *The expected base salary for this position will vary depending on a number of factors, including relevant experience, skills and location.* *In CA: Typical hiring range is $98,568 to $120,473* **Job Summary**  

The **Data Analyst** will provide data and reporting support to the **Data Analyst Team Lead**, helping to drive data\-informed business decisions. In this role, the team member will assist in identifying unprofitable risk segments and uncover opportunities to reduce premium leakage across all lines of business. The team member will also contribute to improving AIS processes and procedures by performing data analysis, creating reports, and supporting the monitoring of underwriting production and goals. This position is ideal for someone eager to develop their skills in data analytics while supporting a lead analyst and contributing to the organization's success.
Responsibilities:
**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:*** **Data Analysis \& Reporting**: Assist in generating on\-demand reports as requested by the **Data Analyst Team Lead** and AIS management, creating standardized reporting templates, and ensuring data accuracy. Support the premium leakage initiative to increase profitability.
* **Collaboration \& Support**: Work independently with AIS leaders to identify and provide data support for process improvements, system changes, and innovative ideas. Present analysis needs and work within a project plan that includes business objectives, data scope, research methodology, resources, and timelines.
* **Reporting \& Productivity Monitoring**: Create, monitor, audit, and analyze recurring reports on CSR and Sales Agent productivity, system behavior, call handling, and AIS processes. Look for opportunities to improve efficiency and prepare reports, graphs, and charts based on analysis.
* **Tools \& Systems Usage**: Coordinate and execute reporting, directing and supporting AIS users and leaders in identifying data needed for reporting. Use tools such as MicroStrategy, Power BI, Winbroker II, Amazon Connect, Taske, and Mercury's Enterprise Data Warehouse to gather and present data.
* **General Support:** Assist in developing and administrating current and future goals within AIS departments. Perform additional functions as the **Data Analyst Team Lead** assigns to support team and company objectives.


Qualifications:
* **Data Analysis \& Reporting**: Proficient in performing data analysis and reporting using **Excel**, **SQL**, and **Power BI**. Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify and address operational challenges and assist in the development of new dashboards and visualizations.
* **Excel Skills**: Strong knowledge of **VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP**, pivot tables, charts, data sorting, and conditional formatting to analyze and present data effectively.
* **Data Visualization**: Experience using **Power BI** (or similar tools like **Tableau**) to create compelling visualizations and metrics. Familiarity with DAX for Power BI or VisQL for Tableau to build insightful and interactive dashboards.
* **Data Modeling \& SQL**: Knowledge of **SQL**, including inner and outer joins, lag/lead functions, case statements, and basic data modeling/design. Ability to create complex queries and support data\-driven decision\-making.
* **Robotic Process Automation**: Basic experience with **UiPath** or **Power Automate** for automating repetitive tasks and improving data workflows.
* **Industry Knowledge**: General understanding of the **Property \& Casualty Insurance** industry, including specific product lines such as **Home**, **Auto**, and **Commercial**.
* **Underwriting \& Analytical Skills**: Strong analytical and quantitative skills with experience in underwriting practices, procedures, and data analysis related to premium and loss ratio analysis.
* **Communication Skills**: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings on underwriting data projects clearly and effectively to management and stakeholders.
* **Project Management \& Time Management**: Capable of producing quality work within tight timeframes, managing multiple projects simultaneously, and working efficiently within a team setting.
* **Learning \& Self\-Development**: Must be a self\-starter who can quickly learn new responsibilities, adapt to new technologies, and learn from peers or independently. Ability to stay up\-to\-date with new industry tools and techniques.
* **Adaptability \& Flexibility**: Ability to work a flexible schedule and travel as needed, including occasional overnight or weekend stays.
* **Confidentiality \& Compliance**: Ability to adhere to the company’s privacy policies and ensure the secure handling of sensitive data.
* **Technical Knowledge Development**: Required to learn **SQL**, **SAS**, and potentially **R** coding if not already familiar, to further enhance data analysis capabilities.

**Education/Experience*** Bachelor’s degree; preferably in Business Administration, Mathematics, or Statistics
* Coursework in statistics or business analytics
* At least 3 years of insurance\-related experience, preferably in an analytical role
* SAS and SQL training
* Or equivalent combination of education and experience
